nodes.description: Public view function allBalances(address[] _tokens, address _who) in BalanceReader; loops over caller-supplied token addresses and queries each wrapper.
External interface function WrapperInterface.balanceOf(address who) invoked on each caller-supplied token address.
External interface function WrapperInterface.depositLock(address who) invoked on each caller-supplied token address.
Parameter _tokens: caller-supplied array of token addresses that determines which external contracts are called.
Parameter _who: caller-supplied address whose balances and locks are read and forwarded to external calls.
Local array balances holding the results of balanceOf for each token.
Local array locks holding the results of depositLock for each token.
Loop counter i used to iterate over the caller-supplied token array.
External call WrapperInterface(_tokens[i]).balanceOf(_who) to an arbitrary caller-controlled contract address.
External call WrapperInterface(_tokens[i]).depositLock(_who) to an arbitrary caller-controlled contract address.

edges.reason: Parameter _tokens is consumed by allBalances to size the return arrays and drive the loop.
Parameter _who is consumed by allBalances as the address being queried.
Each element of the caller-supplied _tokens array becomes the target address of the external balanceOf call.
Each element of the caller-supplied _tokens array becomes the target address of the external depositLock call.
_who is passed unchanged as the argument of the external balanceOf call.
_who is passed unchanged as the argument of the external depositLock call.
Loop index i selects the token address used in the external balanceOf call.
Loop index i selects the token address used in the external depositLock call.
allBalances executes the external balanceOf call inside the loop body.
allBalances executes the external depositLock call inside the loop body.
The external call dispatches into balanceOf on a contract address fully controlled by the caller, which may execute arbitrary code and re-enter the calling contract.
The external call dispatches into depositLock on a contract address fully controlled by the caller, which may execute arbitrary code and re-enter the calling contract.
Return value of the external balanceOf call is stored into the balances array.
Return value of the external depositLock call is stored into the locks array.

normalization_plan.reason: _tokens is a function parameter of allBalances and is fully absorbed into that function's loop and return-array sizing.
_who is a function parameter of allBalances and is fully absorbed into that function's external query logic.
balances is a local return array created and populated entirely within allBalances.
locks is a local return array created and populated entirely within allBalances.
i is a loop counter local to allBalances and has no meaning outside that function.
